title: Handley Page Halifax LV836
memorial_details:
description: Stone of Remembrance:  THIS MEMORIAL IS DEDICATED TO THE CREW OF HALIFAX LV836 FROM 427 LION SQN RCAF/ WHICH CRASHED NEAR HERE IN THE EARLY MORNING OF 21 FEBRUARY 1944/ (names)/ THIS MEMORIAL IS ALSO DEDICATED TO ALL MEMBERS OF BOMBER COMMAND WHO GAVE/ THEIR LIVES IN THE DEFENCE OF FREEDOM 1939 - 1945/ PER ARDUA AD ASTRA

Painting:  IN MEMORY OF THE CREW OF HALIFAX III LV836 ZL-W OF NO 427/ (LION) SQUADRON ROYAL CANADIAN AIR FORCE WHOSE AIRCRAFT/ CRASHED ON ROMANBY GOLF COURSE IMMEDIATELY AFTER TAKE-/ OFF FROM RCAF LEEMING AT 00:02 HOURS ON 21ST FEBRUARY/  1944 WITH THE LOSS OF ALL ON BOARD./ HALIFAX W WAS ON A MISSION TO STUTTGART AND ITS/ BOMB LOAD OF 834 INCENDIARIES EXPLODED ON IMPACT./ (names)
